Multiclassing allows you to gain levels in multiple classes. Doing so lets you mix the abilities of those classes to realize a character concept that might not be reflected in one of the standard class options.

With this rule, you have the option of gaining a level in a new class whenever you advance in level, instead of gaining a level in your current class. Your levels in all your classes are added together to determine your character level. For example, if you have three levels in Wizard and two in Fighter, you're a 5th-level character.

As you advance in levels, you might primarily remain a member of your original class with just a few levels in another class, or you might change course entirely, never looking back at the class you left behind. You might even start progressing in a third or fourth class. Compared to a single-class character of the same level, you'll sacrifice some focus in exchange for versatility.

Prerequisites
To qualify for a new class, you must meet the ability score prerequisites for both your current class and your new one, as shown in the Multiclassing Prerequisites table. For example, a barbarian who decides to multiclass into the druid class must have both Strength and Wisdom scores of 13 or higher. Without the full training that a beginning character receives, you must be a quick study in your new class, having a natural aptitude that is reflected by higher-than-average ability scores.

Class Prerequisite
Warrior 13 Strength
Scout 13 Dexterity
Juggernaut 13 Constitution
Strategist 13 Intelligence
Support Specialist 13 Wisdom
Shikigami User 13 Charisma

Hit Points and Hit Dice
You gain the hit points from your new class as described for levels after 1st. You gain the 1st-level hit points for a class only when you are a 1st-level character.

You add together the Hit Dice granted by all your classes to form your pool of Hit Dice. If the Hit Dice are the same die type, you can simply pool them together. For example, both the fighter and the paladin have a d10, so if you are a paladin 5/fighter 5, you have ten d10 Hit Dice. If your classes give you Hit Dice of different types, keep track of them separately. If you are a paladin 5/cleric 5, for example, you have five d10 Hit Dice and five d8 Hit Dice.

Proficiency Bonus
Your proficiency bonus is always based on your total character level, not your level in a particular class. For example, if you are a Fighter 3/Rogue 2, you have the proficiency bonus of a 5th-level character, which is +3.

Proficiencies
When you gain your first level in a class other than your initial class, you gain only some of the new class's starting proficiencies, as shown in the Multiclassing Proficiencies table.

Class Features
When you gain a new level in a class, you get its features for that level. You don't, however, receive the class's starting equipment, and a few features have additional rules when you're multiclassing: Innate Techniques, Extra Attack, Unarmored Defense, and Spellcasting.

Innate Techniques
If you already have an Innate Technique, you can't gain it again from another class, unless you originally had Body Manipulation. Your Innate Technique counts only your highest class level(You would gain the features from your 3 levels of Warrior, and wouldn’t gain the Innate Technique features from shikigami). You can only use the Innate Technique features one at a time.

Cursed Energy
Similarly to Innate Techniques, you only gain the Cursed Energy of your highest level class, scaling with your total character level.

Extra Attack
If you gain the Extra Attack class feature from multiple classes, the features don't add together. You can't make more than two attacks with this feature unless it says you do (as the fighter's version of Extra Attack does). Similarly, the warlock's eldritch invocation Thirsting Blade doesn't give you additional attacks if you also have an Extra Attack.

Unarmored Defense
If you already have the Unarmored Defense feature, you can't gain it again from another class.

Feats relating to barrier techniques.

Basic Curtain
Prerequisites: 14+ Cursed Energy score

Emerge from the darkness, blacker than darkness. Purify that which is impure. As an action for 5 Cursed Energy, you cover the sky and the ground within a 2165-foot radius dome of darkness for 10 minutes. Upon activation, a dark, almost liquid-like matter drips down from the sky to form the outer barrier wall in the shape of a half-sphere. The curtain changes and the sky becomes dark despite the time of day, provoking any cursed spirits out of hiding. For each extra 1 Cursed Energy spent, you can add 1 additional minute to the curtain's duration and +10 hit points. Your curtain has a number of hit points equal to your Cursed Energy modifier times your level. This barrier has an AC equal to the caster's Cursed Energy DC and automatically fails saving throws. It is also immune to Poison and Psychic damage.

Barrier Intruder
Prerequisites: 18+ Cursed Energy score

You have learned how to invade the barriers of others without breaking them. You gain the following benefits:

  • While outside a barrier, you can make a Cursed Energy check as an action against the CE save DC of the sorcerer who created the barrier to invade it. On a success, you can enter the barrier although the creator will know a creature has entered.

  • While inside a barrier, as an action you can make a Cursed Energy check against the CE save DC of the sorcerer to alter its properties. On a success, you can change the creatures allowed to enter or leave or other properties of the barrier.

Falling Blossom Emotion
Prerequisites: Must have the Clan Sorcerer Background

Unlike Simple Domain, which manifests its own domain to protect against a guaranteed hit, Falling Blossom Emotion shrouds the user in cursed energy to counterattack the moment a domain's guaranteed hit makes contact. As an action or reaction for 5 Cursed Energy, you surround yourself in cursed energy to make any attack or effect with a guaranteed hit nullified and deal no damage. This technique lasts for 1 minute, but does not affect attacks without a guaranteed hit.
You can also use this technique offensively while wielding a melee weapon. As an action for 4 Cursed Energy, you can surround yourself in cursed energy to prepare for an attack for 1 minute. As a reaction to an attack, you can make a melee weapon attack at advantage against the attacker before the attack happens. On a hit, the attack counts as a critical hit and deals necrotic damage. Once you make this attack, you must reactivate the technique to use it again. If your cursed energy or technique alters damage type, it can also alter this damage

Hollow Wicker Basket
Prerequisites: N/A

As an action, bonus action, or reaction against being affected by a sure hit effect of a Domain, or seeing a Domain Expansion open, for 4 Cursed Energy you surround yourself with a 15 ft barrier for 1 minute. Within that radius, the sure hit effect of a domain is negated and deals no damage. Anyone of your choice inside the barrier is unaffected. The barrier has no effect on normal cursed techniques or others entering the barrier. It only negates sure hit effects.

Incomplete Domain
Prerequisites: 1 Breakthrough

You learn to prematurely create an incomplete Domain Expansion. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you create an unrefined incomplete domain 100 ft around yourself for 1 minute. This structureless domain does not follow you, has a refinement of 0, and has no barrier.
The domain lacks a guaranteed hit, but you gain advantage on technique attack rolls and creatures inside your domain have disadvantage on saving throws against your Innate Technique. Any effects of your domain are halved until you gain your complete Domain Expansion, upon which you can choose a different feat. When the domain ends, you experience Technique Burnout for 5 rounds. See Incomplete Domain (pg 451) in Rules of Thumb for further explanation.
Simple Domain
Prerequisites: 16+ Cursed Energy score

As an action or reaction against an attack roll or saving throw effect, spell or domain expansion opening for 4 Cursed Energy, you surround yourself with a 10 ft barrier for 1 minute. The circle has an amount of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus times twice your Cursed Energy modifier. Any damaging cursed techniques, spells, or attacks that target you or targets an area that overlaps with your simple domain, will now damage the barrier instead, reducing its hit points by the damage it would cause. Any damage leftover from an attack or effect that would damage you carries over after Simple Domain is destroyed. Your Simple Domain ends if you move.

Refined Domain
Prerequisites: Must have Domain Expansion, 400 Refinement points

Your refinement allows you to further empower your domain expansion. You can choose one of the following benefits:

  • Severe Danification. If your domain has a passive effect that causes damage at Initiative 20, the number of damage dice are increased by your CE modifier.

  • Non-Lethality. If your domain is Non-Lethal or has a restriction, you can add an additional condition or restriction to your technique.

  • Cost Reduction. Your domain refinement enhances the technique imbued into the barrier. While within your domain, the CE cost of your innate technique features are halved(rounded up).

  • Lightning Speed Release. Your domain refinement has made your techniques faster. Your innate technique features action costs reduced by one while your domain is active (Action > Bonus Action > Reaction > Free Action).

  • Multiplication. Your domain has multiplied the output of the imbued innate technique. When a feature lets you spend up to a certain amount of cursed energy, that maximum amount is doubled.

  • Improved Technique. Your imbued technique has been refined. While within your domain, you can choose one of your Innate Technique features. The damage dice of that technique increases by your CE modifier.

Feats related to your Cursed Energy in its pure and fundamental form, and how to utilize it.

Bottomless Cursed Energy
Prerequisites: 20+ Cursed Energy Score and a Breakthrough

You have touched both the core of Cursed Energy and the hidden Cursed Energy within you. Your Cursed Energy maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level, your Cursed Energy maximum increases by 2 Cursed Energy.

Immense Cursed Energy
Prerequisites: 15+ Cursed Energy Score

Your Cursed Energy has massive reserves, making you become a cursed energy powerhouse. You gain the following benefits:

  • You gain a +1 to your Cursed Energy score (maximum of 20).

  • Your CE maximum increases by your Cursed Energy modifier.

Malevolent Cursed Energy
Prerequisites: Cursed Energy Score 20+

Your soul is rotten, and your cursed energy shows that. As an action, you release your cursed energy and creatures within 100 ft must make a Wisdom saving throw against your cursed energy DC. On a success, they can feel your cruelty but are not shaken by it. On failure, they are frightened and receive one of the following detriments for 1 minute:

  • They hesitate to act due to your suffocating presence, their ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls are reduced by your Cursed Energy modifier.

  • Your power makes them become paralyzed in fear, they have a disadvantage on your saving throws.

  • If the creature's CR or level is equal to or higher than your level, they make this saving throw with advantage. If the creature's CR or level is 3 or more below your level, they make this saving throw with disadvantage.

A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of their turn. Once a creature passes this saving throw, it becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.
Cursed Energy Perception
Prerequisites: Must have proficiency in Perception

You have learned how to track down remains of cursed energy. You gain Expertise in Perception if you don't already. You also gain a +5 bonus to checks relating to sensing Cursed Energy and can sense cursed energy from 90 ft away.

Cursed Enhancement
Prerequisite: N/A

As a bonus action while touching a weapon, you can spend cursed energy up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to enhance that weapon. The weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for every cursed energy spent (to a maximum of +3) for 1 hour. This does not stack with a weapon’s bonus if it already has a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Cursed Imbuement
Prerequisites: N/A

When attacking with unarmed strikes or a weapon you are proficient with, you can use your Cursed Energy modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for your attack and damage rolls. However, on a roll of natural one for an attack roll, you must make a Cursed Energy check against your Cursed Energy DC, or shatter the weapon as you overcharge it or take 1 necrotic damage if using unarmed strikes.
Additionally, you can spend 1 cursed energy to imbue it into an object for 1 minute, causing it to deal necrotic damage for the duration.

Curse Enhanced Body
Prerequisites: 18+ Cursed Energy score

You can enhance your body with Cursed energy. While not wearing armor, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to your AC. This becomes half your modifier (rounded up) if you have a feature such as Unarmored Defense.
Additionally, you can use your Cursed Energy modifier for unarmed strikes in place of Strength or Dexterity. As a reaction you can spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier and gain a bonus to a physical saving throw equal to the cursed energy spent. If you have Reverse Cursed Technique, you can also use this feature for mental saving throws.

Cursed Energy Slash
Prerequisites: Cursed Imbuement or Cursed Enhancement

As an action while holding a weapon that deals slashing damage, you can spend 5 Cursed Energy to make a huge cursed energy slash. You make all creatures in a 15 ft cone or a 30 ft line make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon’s normal damage + additional damage dice equal to a single die of the weapon times your Cursed Energy modifier in necrotic damage. On a success, they take half as much (Eg. Greatsword with a +3 CE modifier would be 2d6 + 3d6 necrotic damage).

Improved Cursed Energy Output
Prerequisites: 18+ Cursed Energy score

As opposed to simply forcing cursed energy into use for your abilities, you have become far more efficient in their output resulting in a dramatic boost in power.

  • When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy, you can spend 1 additional cursed energy. This increases to 2 CE at 6th level and 3 CE at 11th level.

  • Once per turn, you can increase the damage of an attack by your cursed energy modifier.

  • You can choose to shield yourself as a reaction, you can spend 1 CE to reduce an instance of damage by three times your Cursed Energy modifier.

Cursed Energy Trait
Prerequisites: 1st level

Your cursed energy has taken on a unique quality, choose one:
Rough. You gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls and +2 bonus to damage rolls when using your raw cursed energy (such as cursed strike).
Smooth. You gain a +1 bonus to AC and your walking speed increases by 5 ft. As a reaction to an attack, you can spend 1 CE to gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Elemental. Pick a damage type other than radiant or necrotic. When a feature uses raw cursed energy to deal damage, you can deal that damage type instead, dealing additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Cursed Energy Trait Mastery
Prerequisites: Cursed Energy Trait

You have mastered the trait peculiar to your energy:
Rough. You gain a bonus to damage rolls using raw cursed energy equal to 2 + your CE modifier (such as cursed strike). This replaces the bonus to damage rolls from your Cursed Energy Trait.
Smooth. You reduce bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage by your CE modifier and your walking speed increases by 10 ft. This replaces the bonus to walking speed from your Cursed Energy Trait. As a reaction to an attack for 1 CE, you gain a bonus to AC equal to twice your CE modifier, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Elemental. Once per turn on a hit imbued with raw cursed energy (eg. Cursed Strike) or a creature failing a save against your raw cursed energy (eg. Cursed Energy Slash), they suffer an additional effect. These effects stack up to your proficiency bonus (if applicable) and last a number of turns equal to your CE modifier:

  • Acid, reduces the target’s AC by 1

  • Bludgeoning, ignores resistance to bludgeoning

  • Cold, reduces movement by 10 ft

  • Fire, target takes an extra 2 fire damage from your cursed energy

  • Force, target is knocked back 10 ft

  • Lightning, the target cannot take reactions

  • Piercing, ignores resistance to piercing

  • Poison, target gains the Poisoned condition

  • Psychic, target gains the frightened condition

  • Slashing, ignores resistance to slashing

  • Thunder, target is knocked Prone and Deafened

Cursed Projectiles
Prerequisites: Proficiency in a Ranged or Thrown weapon

You have learned to imbue your cursed energy into projectiles such as arrows, bolts or any other type of ammunition or weapon with the thrown property. As an action, you can imbue a number of projectiles up to your Cursed Energy modifier, turning them into Cursed Projectiles until you finish a long rest. When using Cursed Projectiles, you make ranged Cursed Energy attacks instead of what you would normally use to attack with them, and you control their trajectory while in the air, making it so that attacks with them ignore half and three quarters cover.

Additionally, on a miss they will stay in the air floating for a number of rounds equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, allowing you to keep making attacks with them even after being shot or thrown until they hit a solid object or target. You can use a bonus action to cause each active Cursed Projectile to make another ranged Cursed Energy attack against a creature within 60 feet. You can control a number of Cursed Projectiles equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. A creature can attack your Cursed Projectiles to destroy them; they have 1 hit point and an AC equal to your Cursed Technique DC.

One In A Billion
Prerequisites: 20+ Cursed Energy score, 15th level, Breakthrough
Your cursed energy manipulation is some of the best that the world has ever seen, it must take at least a couple of centuries for another person such as yourself to be born once again. You gain the following benefits:

  • If a feature deals damage you can reroll all 1s and 2s on damage dice. Once per long rest you can deal maximum damage on a technique you use. This does not include ordinary attacks from you or shikigami.

  • Once per long rest, you can use one feature that requires Cursed Energy. The cost of that feature is lowered to 0 for that use, if a feature depends on how much Cursed Energy you spend, it counts as if you used the maximum required. For example, Reverse Cursed Technique would heal 50 with a modifier of +5.

Pact Maker
Prerequisites: N/A

You have specialized in the intricacies of binding vows, causing you to understand their innate workings. You can now make a number of binding vows equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
Chanting
Prerequisites: 12th level+

You can set a recitation of chanting for one of your innate technique features. You recite your chant as a full turn action and must concentrate until the technique is released. If you lose concentration, the cursed energy spent on the technique is wasted. When you use the technique on your next turn after reciting your chant, it will be given the following boost:

  • Your technique will ignore resistances and treat immunities as resistance.

  • If your Innate Technique feature is an attack, it gains advantage on the attack roll. If it instead requires a saving throw, the target(s) make their saves at disadvantage.

  • Your Technique feature deals double the damage dice.

If your Innate Technique does not directly deal damage, you can choose the following options:

  • The technique's range doubles.

  • The technique can target an additional number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

  • You can double the duration of the Innate Technique feature.

If your Innate Technique feature that benefits from Chanting requires more than one attack or damage roll or save to be made, only the first gains the benefits of Chanting. You cannot use Maximum Output or Domain Expansion while Chanting.

Blessed by Black Sparks
Prerequisites: N/A

The sparks of black have chosen you to receive their blessings. You gain a +3 bonus to your Black Flash range.

Shikigami Specialist
Prerequisite: Must be able to summon shikigami

You have specialized in shikigami and made it your life. Choose one type of shikigami you can summon to be your special. You have a number of Ability points equal to twice your proficiency bonus that you can use to increase the ability score of that shikigami (up to a max of 20). Additionally, you can command any of your shikigami as a free action on your turn. This does not let you command a shikigami multiple times per turn. If you have multiple shikigami, you can swap your special shikigami as part of a long rest.

Athlete
Prerequisites: N/A

You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.

  • Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.

  • You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

Charger
Prerequisites: N/A

When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack’s damage roll (if you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10 feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).

Defensive Duelist
Prerequisites: 13+ Dex

When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

Dual Wielder
Prerequisites: N/A

You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits:

  • You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.

  • You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light.

  • You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

Durable
Prerequisites: N/A

Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:

  • Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

Crusher
Prerequisites: N/A

You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies, granting you the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you.

  • When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with advantage until the start of your next turn.

Fighting Initiate
Prerequisites: N/A

Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of fighting. As a result, you learn one Fighting Style option of your choice from the Heavenly Restriction class. If you already have a style, the one you choose must be different.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat's fighting style with another one from the Heavenly Restriction class that you don't have.

Grappler
Prerequisites: 13+ Str

You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

  • You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

  • You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

Great Weapon Master
Prerequisites: N/A

You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits:

  • On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.

  • Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

Heavy Armor Master
Prerequisites: N/A

You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits, on top of Heavy armor proficiency:

  • Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.

Lightly Armored
Prerequisites: N/A

You have trained to master the use of light armor, gaining the following benefits.

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You gain proficiency with light armor.

Martial Adept
Prerequisites: N/A

You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits.
You learn two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
You gain one superiority die, which is a d6 (this die is added to any superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

Medium Armor Master
Prerequisites: N/A

You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits, on top of proficiency with medium armor:

  • Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

  • When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

Mobile
Prerequisites: N/A

You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits:

  • Your speed increases by 10 feet.

  • When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.

  • When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

Peak Form
Prerequisite: Level 10+

You gain 1 body point that can be spent on a Body Improvement from the Heavenly Restriction class. You must fulfill any prerequisites before taking it and you use your total level for the purpose of fulfilling prerequisites.

Piercer
Prerequisites: N/A

You have achieved a penetrating precision in combat, granting you the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals piercing damage, you can re-roll one of the attack’s damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

  • When you score a critical hit that deals piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra piercing damage the target takes.

Polearm Master
Prerequisites: N/A

You gain the following benefits:

  • When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack. The weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4, and it deals bludgeoning damage.

  • While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

Resilient
Prerequisites: N/A

Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits:

  • Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

Savage Attacker
Prerequisites: N/A

Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

Shield Master
Prerequisites: N/A

You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You gain the following benefits while you are wielding a shield:

  • If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield.

  • If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you.

  • If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

Slasher
Prerequisites: N/A

You've learned where to cut to have the greatest results, granting you the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage, you can reduce the speed of the target by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

  • When you score a critical hit that deals slashing damage to a creature, you grievously wound it. Until the start of your next turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.

Tavern Brawler
Prerequisites: N/A

Accustomed to the rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1 (max of 20).

  • You are proficient with improvised weapons.

  • When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

Tough
Prerequisites: N/A

Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

Cursed Technique Reversal
Prerequisites: Must have Reverse Cursed Technique

You have learned to feed your cursed techniques with reverse cursed energy instead of normal. This leads your technique to have the opposite of its normal effect. Turning debuffing into buffing and inverting damage types, resulting in a Reversal.

Reverse Cursed Technique Output
Prerequisites: Must have Reverse Cursed Technique

You have learned to offensively use reverse curse technique, whenever you deal damage to a Monstrosity, Undead, or Cursed Spirit with an unarmed strike or melee weapon, you can spend cursed energy to remove hit points from your healing pool adding them as radiant damage.

Reverse Technique Prodigy
Prerequisites: Must have Reverse Cursed Technique

You have reached new heights with this new type of energy, becoming an unheard prodigy. You can cause a creature you touch to gain the benefits of reverse cursed technique instead of you and can use reverse cursed technique once per turn as a free action.

2000 IQ
Prerequisites: Proficiency in Arcana

You can make an Intelligence (Arcana) check as a bonus action while viewing a technique in play to understand how it works. The DC is equal to the user’s Cursed Energy save DC.
When making this check, treat your Intelligence score as a 22. If you instead spend a full turn action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) attempting to understand a technique, you have advantage on the check.

Actor
Prerequisites: N/A

Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:

  • Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You have an advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.

  • You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

Alert
Prerequisites: N/A

Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:

  • You can't be surprised while you are conscious.

  • You gain a +5 bonus to initiative.

  • Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

Chef
Prerequisites: N/A

Time and effort spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off. You gain the following benefits:

  • Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You gain proficiency with cook’s utensils if you don’t already have it.

  • As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and cook's utensils on hand. “Oh, them's fighting words”, you have found a way to make your words insulting. When using a word you can force the enemy to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you.

Quick Tongue
Prerequisites: Must have Interjection

Your versatility and training have increased the amount of words you have and your speed. You can choose one more word to be under the effect of Interjection.

Megaphone
Prerequisites: Must have Resounding Voice

You have found a way to increase your power using an outside tool. For 3 Cursed Energy you can create or imbue a megaphone for 1 minute that causes your words to affect a 60-foot cone. The megaphone has hit points equal to twice your CE score and damages the megaphone instead of your vocal chords when used in this way. When reduced to 0 hit points, the megaphone turns to dust.

Cursed Spirit Manipulation

Curse Restoration
Prerequisites: Must have Curse Infused Spirits

You have learned to weaponize the affinity cursed spirits have and utilize to regenerate and can activate it using your own cursed energy. Once per turn as an action, bonus action, or reaction you can spend up to your cursed energy modifier to restore 5 hit points per cursed energy spent to a cursed spirit you have summoned within 60 ft of you. At 11th level this becomes 10 hit points per cursed energy.

Defensive Summoning
Prerequisites: Must have Perfect Control

Your reaction speed and control over your Cursed Spirits has increased. As a reaction, for 5 Cursed Energy you can summon a CR 5 or lower cursed spirit that takes as much of the triggering damage as it can. You take any remaining damage. If it survives, it then lands in an unoccupied area within 5 ft of you.

Minimum: Uzumaki
Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Uzumaki

Due to your extended studies, you have made a smaller version of Uzumaki that's more deadly and much harder to dodge. As a bonus action, you can spend two cursed spirits to create a miniature Uzumaki that fits in your hand. It can't be seen by the creature unless its passive Perception is 25 or higher, or the creature succeeds a Perception check. As an action or reaction for 5 Cursed Energy, you can release all the condensed energy from this Uzumaki at a target within 30 feet. Make a ranged cursed energy attack roll, on a hit the target takes Xd12 of necrotic damage(X being the combined CR of the 2 curses). Like Maximum Uzumaki, this ignores resistance and treats immunity like resistance. You have advantage on your attack roll if the target has not detected your Minimum Uzumaki.
Similar to Maximum Uzumaki, you can obtain actions, reactions, bonus actions, and legendary actions of the creature's technique.

Cursed Transmutation

Amplified Transmute
Prerequisite: Must have Basic Transmutations

You have learned to amplify your transmutations with modified formulas and stronger cursed energy. The AC of a Transmuted Object increases by your proficiency bonus and has 15 hit points per 5 ft cube. This increases to 20 at 3rd level, 30 at 6th level, 45 at 11th level and 60 at 18th level.

Additional Formulae
Prerequisite: Must have Chemical Formulae

You can choose to gain two of the following options (This feat can be taken more than once):
Transmute Explosion (3 CE). As an action, you transmute the chemical composition of a 10 ft cube of air within 60 ft of you creating an explosion. All creatures within that cube must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5d6 fire damage or half as much on a success. This becomes 8d6 at 11th level and 14d6 at 18th level.
Modify Attributes (2 CE). As a bonus action, you swap your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution scores for 1 minute (can end it as a free action).
Pressurization (3 CE). As an action, you transmute the pressure of the air around you for up to 1 minute while concentrating. For the duration, you gain a 15 ft fly speed. This increases to 25 ft at 6th level, 40 ft at 11th level and 60 ft at 18th level.
Transmute Element (1 CE). When you deal a damage type from the following list, you can spend 1 CE to change that damage type to one of the other listed types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder.

Transmute Aether
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Railgun

Whether through chance or experimentation, you have learned to transmute an unknown element that cannot logically exist. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you transmute a 5 ft sphere of air or material you touch into a 5 ft cube of Aether for 1 minute. Any creature other than you that comes into contact with or hits the Aether with a melee attack within 5 ft of it takes 20d4 necrotic damage. A creature can only take this damage once per turn and it ignores immunity and resistances. The Aether has an AC of 1 and 100 hit points.
You are able to touch the Aether harmlessly and pass through it as if it were difficult terrain. You can move or reshape the Aether as an action while it is within 100 ft of you. You can move it up to 30 ft and if the Aether enters another creature’s space, it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 20d4 necrotic damage. If you reshape the Aether, you can change its shape or split it into two smaller spheres. Touching these smaller cubes instead deals 10d4 necrotic damage.
You can only move one cube of Aether at a time no matter what size it is. While within 5 ft of Aether, you can spend half your movement to enter the Aether’s space and reappear from another Aether cube.

Dark Claw

Close Combat Specialist
Prerequisite: Must have Claw

When you hit a creature with a claw attack while within 5 ft, you can attempt to grapple the creature as a bonus action. While grappling a creature, you can cause the creature to take your claw damage at the start of their turn.

Drill Claws
Prerequisite: Must have Claw Modifications

You have learned to control the length of your claws. As a bonus action, you lengthen your claws and increase your melee reach with them by 5 ft for 1 minute or until you retract them as a bonus action.

Additionally, you learn to shoot out your claws as projectiles. Once per turn when you take the Attack action you can spend 1 CE to replace one of your attacks with a Drill Claw attack. You make a ranged Claw attack using your Strength, Dexterity, or Cursed Energy modifier against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit, this attack deals 4d8 piercing damage. This increases to 6d8 at 6th level, 8d8 at 11th level and 10d8 at 18th level. The range of this attack doubles at 6th level.

Cutting Edge
Prerequisite: Must have Ultimate Claws

You have learned to sharpen your claws with cursed energy. You gain a +1 bonus to critical range with your Claws and can reroll and 1s or 2s when rolling damage for your Claws. The bonus to critical range increases to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 18th level.

Deadly Sentencing

Tool Versatility
Prerequisites: Must have Judge’s Gavel

Through a broadening of your understanding over your gavel. On top of your normal forms, you can turn your Gavel into any melee weapon. You also gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls using your Gavel. This increases to a +2 bonus at 6th level and +3 bonus at 11th level. The Executioner’s Sword does not gain this bonus.

Weight of Judgment
Prerequisites: Must have Deadly Sentencing

When you hit a creature with your Judge’s Gavel, you can spend 2 cursed energy to deal double the weapon’s damage die. Additionally, the creature must make a Strength saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

Judgeman Release
Prerequisites: Must have Gavel Improvements

Your attunement with Deadly Sentencing has allowed you to summon Judgeman outside the domain. As a bonus action for 5 Cursed Energy, you summon Judgeman for 1 minute. Every time your opponent attacks you, they are penalized for assault and the opponent gains a -1 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws. If a creature targets you with a cursed technique that is not an attack roll, they gain a -1 penalty to their CE save DC. These penalties last until Judgeman disappears.

Disaster Flames

Pyrokinesis
Prerequisites: Must have Flames of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your flames. You gain the one of the following (This feat can be taken more than once):

  • Resistance to Fire Damage and when you roll damage for a technique that deals fire damage, you can reroll any 1s, but must take the new result, even if the new roll is a 1.

  • Two spells below 5th level dealing fire damage. The ce cost equals the spell’s level.

Shooting Star
Prerequisites: Must have Erupting Volcanoes

Through focus and thorough planning, you have gained further ideas. As a bonus action, you can spend Cursed Energy up to CE modifier to gain a 60 foot fly speed that lets you hover for a number of rounds equal to your CE modifier per Cursed Energy spent. For example, if you spend 2 CE with a modifier of +3, you can fly for 6 rounds.

Hellscape
Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Meteor

Your presence can now be felt, all around. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you can cause all non magical objects and structures of your choice in a 100 ft radius to melt. As an action you can either control move the lava 10 ft in any direction (must have area to spread to) or control it directly to make two cursed energy attacks against a creature within 60 ft of the Hellscape area, dealing 10d8 fire damage on a hit. Each creature that enters the lava or starts their turn touching the lava must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. The lava cools after 10 minutes.

Disaster Storms

Aerokinesis
Prerequisite: Must have Storms of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications for your storms. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

  • Suffocation. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see. They must make a Constitution saving throw, taking your proficiency bonus in d6s of necrotic damage and start suffocating on a failed save. While suffocating their movement is halved and their attack rolls have disadvantage. If you are more than 30 ft away or lose concentration, the target stops suffocating.

  • Resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

Flying Nimbus
Prerequisite: Must have Storm Creation

While using Storm Creation, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. When you use Storms of Disaster while flying, you can immediately move up to 10 ft without spending movement or provoking opportunity attacks.

Squall
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Divine Storm Sovereign

While you are within a storm of your creation, your movement speed increases by 20 ft and you can teleport to a different point within the storm as a bonus action. Additionally when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can instead melt into storms and reconstitute your form at a different point within the storm at 1 hit point. Once you reconstitute your body using this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

Disaster Tides

Hydrokinesis
Prerequisites: Must have Tides of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your water. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

  • Piercing Water: You make a small water beam made to pierce through enemies. As an action for 2 CE, you make a cursed energy attack against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit, they take 2d10 cold damage + 2d6 piercing damage and are forced to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked prone and will receive the damage rolled one additional time as a vital organ is hit. On a success, they don't take additional damage and are not prone.

  • Two water spells below 5th level. The ce cost equals the spell’s level in Cursed Energy.

Shoal
Prerequisites: Must have Horizon of Captivating Skhanda

You have increased your technique’s potential. You can now use Death Swarm outside your domain without the sure hit effect. You can have a number of shikigami equal to your Cursed Energy modifier when used in this way. The number of shikigami increases by your CE modifier at 6th level (2x), 11th level (3x), and 18th level (4x).

Typhoon
Prerequisites: Must have Water Defensive Ring

The scale and power of the water ring surrounding you has increased. For an extra 2 cursed energy, it also creates a 20 ft radius sphere of whirling storm that is centered on and follows you. Each creature other than you in the sphere when it appears or that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The sphere’s space is difficult terrain.
Until the technique ends, you can use a bonus action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from you toward a creature within 60 feet, making a cursed energy attack. You have advantage on the attack if the target is in the sphere. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 lightning damage. Creatures within 30 feet of the sphere have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear.

Disaster Verdure

Chlorokinesis
Prerequisites: Must have Forest of Disaster

Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your roots. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

  • You can transform your root wall into any of the other forms as a bonus action.

  • Two spells below 5th level dealing with nature. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

Bouquet
Prerequisites: Must have Flower Field

You have found a way to do more with less. As an action, for 3 Cursed Energy you can cause the effects of Flower Field on a single creature you can see.

Sapping Roots
Prerequisites: Must have Cursed Bud

Your power has increased and been honed. As an action, for 5 Cursed Energy you give yourself the ability to drain Cursed Energy for 1 minute. On a hit with a melee attack or if you damage a creature with your Innate Technique, they lose 1 cursed energy which you gain.

Disaster Vermin

Reinforced Vermin
Prerequisite: Must have Vermin of Disaster

As part of the bonus action you take to command your Insect Swarms, you can spend 2 cursed energy to reinforce one of your Insect Swarms with cursed energy for 1 minute. While reinforced, their size category increases by one and they deal an additional 2 damage dice on a successful Bites attack (only +1 if bloodied). If you use multiple Reinforced Insect Swarms to form a Vermin Swarm, it only gains these benefits once.

Vermin Techniques
Prerequisite: Must have Almighty Swarm

You have learned to better control the combined actions of your Vermin Swarms, allowing you to learn the following ways to use your Swarms:
Insect Cloak. While you are occupying the same space as one of your Vermin Swarms, you can treat the Swarm’s hit points as temporary hit points for yourself.
Grasping Hand. You can spend 3 CE to replace one of your attacks on your turn with a grapple check through one of your Insect Swarms against a creature within 5 ft of the swarm. Instead of an Athletics check, you make a Cursed Energy (Arcana) check. The grapple gains a +1 bonus and +5 ft of range per size category above Medium the swarm is. On a success, the creature is grappled and can be pulled into the Insect Swarm.
Transport Via Bugs. As an action for 6 CE, you form a link between one Large or larger Vermin Swarm within 10 ft and connect it to another Large or larger Vermin Swarm at any distance. Before the end of your turn, you can spend 5 ft of movement to walk into the space of the Insect Swarm within 5 ft, reappearing within 5 ft of the destination Insect Swarm.

Festering Life Sword
Prerequisite: Must have Parthenogenesis

As a bonus action for 6 CE, you transform a weapon you are holding. It loses all previous benefits and becomes the Special Grade Cursed Tool: Festering Life Sword. You can only have one weapon transformed this way at a time and this tool disappears when you finish a long rest or die.

Divergent Fist

Black Belt
Prerequisites: Must have Martial Prowess

Through much training, you gain the following martial options:

  • Takedown: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can try to grapple or shove the target as a bonus action.

  • Judo Throw: When you hit a grappled creature with a melee attack, you can grab the target and flip them on their back. If the target is Huge or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock them prone, and if they fail it by 5 or more they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

  • Flying Drop Kick: You can use an action to jump up and land a Flying Drop Kick. You target a creature within your jump distance with an unarmed attack (Calculator here). The target takes your unarmed damage, and is pushed back 30ft.

Opportunistic Blow
Prerequisites: Must have Extreme Divergent Flow

You take full advantage of the unpredictability of your attacks. After a Divergent Flow is landed, you can force the enemy to make a Cursed Energy check against your DC. On a failure, you notice their distraction and can use your reaction to make an attack against them at advantage.

Maximum: Soul Punch
Prerequisites: Must have Chosen by the Sparks

You have mastered your ability to target the soul. Before you make an unarmed strike, you can choose to spend 5 CE to cause any unarmed strikes you make on your turn to target the soul of a creature you attack. These attacks’ damage reduces the target’s maximum hit point (this does not include additional damage like Cursed Strike). This technique is a Reduced Output Effect that gives 1 level of Reduced Output when you deal damage to them with Soul Punch. This can cause a number of levels of Reduced Output up to your Cursed Energy modifier per target and no more. These levels of Reduced Output last until the target takes a short or long rest.

Dragon Vein

Ley Line Extension
Prerequisite: Must have Ley Line Command

You have learned to extend the benefits of your connection with the earth to others. When you create a Ley Line you can give a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier the benefits of Flow of the Dragon while they are within 30 ft and touching the same ground as you.

Ground Control
Prerequisite: Must have Earth Dragon Soul

As an action for 3 CE, you stomp your foot and transform the ground within 30 ft in one of the following ways:

  • The ground becomes difficult terrain for all creatures other than yourself.

  • All creatures touching the ground other than you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they are knocked prone.

  • You grant creatures of your choice within range three quarters cover until the end of your next turn with earthen walls.

  • You move one creature touching the ground with a wave of earth up to 20 ft horizontally to a point within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the effect.

Maximum: Dragon Pulse
Prerequisite: Must have World Anchor

As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) for 8 CE, you stomp your foot forcing all creatures within 120 ft that are touching the ground or at least 30 ft above the ground to make a Strength saving throw as you cause a massive shockwave that shatters the earth around you.
On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. Objects and structures automatically fail this saving throw and take maximum damage. For every creature that fails this save, you gain 5 temporary hit points.

Earth Manipulation

Density Manipulation
Prerequisites: Must have Excavation

You have learned to increase the density of your stone creations. The amount of hit points each cube created by your Excavation now equals 10 times your CE modifier. Stone constructs created by your other Innate Technique features gain an additional 10 hit points.

Rock Burst
Prerequisites: Must have Sculpted Earth

As a reaction, you can cause one of your stone constructs within 60 feet of you to explode. Any creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 1d12 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone. You can spend CE up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) as part of this reaction to heighten the explosion and deal an additional 1d12 bludgeoning damage per CE and cause creatures in range to take half as much damage on a success.

Arms of the Giant
Prerequisite: Must have Stone Arms

You are no longer required to maintain concentration to maintain your Stone Arms. Additionally, while spending 1 CE each turn to maintain your hands, you are able to control your Stone Arms as if casting the spell Bigby’s Hand. A creature that gains the restrained condition from your Stone Arms has their movement speed halved for 1 minute or until they regain hit points.

Eight Heads

Snake Scales
Prerequisites: Must have Eight Lives

As an action for 4 cursed energy, you summon the scales of Yamata no Orochi to protect your flesh. Your AC cannot be lower than 14 + your proficiency bonus and you become resistant to poison and slashing damage for 1 hour.

Blessing of the Hydra
Prerequisites: Must have Collective Will

When you use Eight Lives to return to life, you can gain resistance to one damage type that reduced you to 0 hit points or immunity to one harmful condition you had. This benefit lasts for 1 hour.

Fang Versatility
Prerequisites: Must have Fangs of Orochi

You have trained your technique to be more versatile in combat. You can wield Fangs or Orochi as a Dagger or Shortsword. On a hit with this weapon, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes an additional 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. Your Fang Shikigami gain the following improvements:

  • The AC of your Fangs becomes 15 + your proficiency bonus.

  • Your Fangs deal an additional 2d4 poison damage on a hit.

Incarnation
Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Sacrifice

When you use Sacrifice and kill a humanoid, instead of gaining a life, you can summon a Head of Orochi as a shikigami under your control. You can control or unsummon the head as a bonus action or summon it as an action for 3 CE later, being stored somewhere on your body as a tattoo of the head of a snake. This replaces one of your Fangs of Orochi shikigami you can have active at once.

Once you have used Sacrifice to gain all eight heads, the tattoos come together to form a knot on your chest. As a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement), you can complete the ritual and incarnate the Special Grade Cursed Spirit: Yamata no Orochi as a shikigami in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of you.

Esoteric Art

Diptych
Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Painting

You have learned to fold, expand, and even connect the subspaces of your paintings. When you enter one of your painting subspaces, you can spend 4 cursed energy to exit from one of your physical paintings. Additionally, the number of paintings you can have at once increases by your proficiency bonus and the area of your subspace doubles.

Air Brush
Prerequisite: Must have Impasto Canvas

As a reaction to an attack roll, you can spend 1 Cursed Energy to add +4 to your AC against the attack by forming a cursed painting, storing the attack in your subspace on a miss. If you have taken the dodge action, you can use this reaction on allies within 5 feet.
Once per turn when you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to replace one of your attacks on your turn with an attack from a Giant Ink Shikigami. Make a melee cursed energy attack against a creature you can see within 30 ft. You create a painting of cursed energy and one of your Ink Shikigami attacks from the painting, dealing 3d10 + your CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit. This increases to 4d10 at 6th level and 5d10 at 11th level.

Gradient
Prerequisite: Must have Sgraffito

As an action for 5 cursed energy, you create a subspace Gradient that fills a 30 ft cube centered on you for 1 minute. You can use your innate technique features within this subspace, but they cannot extend beyond it and disappear once the technique ends. The subspace is stationary and does not move with you. At 11th level, you can increase the size of the cube to 60 ft.
Alternatively, instead of using your innate technique features within Gradient, you can instead enhance your spatial awareness. You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within the subspace. While Gradient is active, you can use your reaction to add your CE modifier to an attack roll, saving throw, or AC against one attack roll. While using Gradient this way, you cannot use Impasto Canvas.

Explosive Flesh

Reduced Harm
Prerequisite: Must have Faster Throws

You have learned to minimize the damage you take when using your technique. You decrease the hit point loss from using any part of your body as an explosive by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hit point).
At 6th level, this reduction increases to an amount equal to twice your Constitution modifier plus your level (minimum 1 hit point).

Elemental Bomb
Prerequisite: Must have Guerilla Tactics

You have learned how to create different types of explosions, making them create different effects. You can spend additional cursed energy equal to the energy spent in using the bomb to make them an elemental bomb. The elemental bomb will deal additional dice of fire, cold or lightning damage, equal to the original bombs' damage.

Maximum: Bites the Dust
Prerequisite: Must have Stronger Explosions

Your explosive prowess has reached new heights, allowing you to trigger massive blasts from your removed body parts. As an action, you can spend cursed energy equal to the body part to trigger a delayed explosion. Choose a body part you have removed within 30 ft. It detonates at the end of your next turn, forcing all creatures within 20 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, they take Xd12 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. You can spend additional cursed energy up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to increase the damage by an additional Xd12 for every cursed energy spent. The X is your Cursed Energy modifier.

Fa Jin

Kinetic Absorption
Prerequisite: Must have Store and Release

As a reaction to bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, you can spend 1 cursed energy to reduce the incoming damage by your Cursed Energy score and gain 1 Jin Charge. You cannot reduce the damage of other damage types.

Instantaneous Charge
Prerequisite: Must have Instantaneous Movement

When you use at least 3 Jin charges for Instantaneous Movement, you gain advantage on your next melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal additional thunder damage equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

Maximum: Destructive Release
Prerequisite: Must have Maximize Potential

You have learned the method to magnify your destructive power. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 CE before using Fist of Explosive Power. You deal three damage die per Jin charge spent and all targets gain a -3 to their saving throw, being launched back 10 feet on a failed save, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage if they hit an object, creature or structure.

Faceless God

Veil of the Faceless God
Prerequisite: Must have Madness Inducement

As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, your face is adorned with a veil for 1 minute. A creature with at least 10% corruption that can see you must make an Intelligence saving throw at the beginning of their turn. On a failed save, they gain a -1 to all rolls for every 10% corruption they have until the start of their next turn (does not stack with Theia Mania). An affected creature repeats the save at the start of their turn, ending the effect on a success and automatically succeeds the save if it cannot see you.

Hands of Madness
Prerequisite: Must have Obsession and Insanity

As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, you summon either the Left Hand or Right Hand for 10 minutes. Attacks made with a Hand of Madness increases Mental Corruption by 5% once per turn, even when your technique is not activated. You can only have one hand active at a time. At 11th level, you can spend 6 CE as a bonus action to use both.

Right Hand. The Right Hand of Madness covers your right hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see a horrid arm of rotting flesh, wriggling tendrils, or similarly terrifying to them. An unarmed strike made with your right hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d12 psychic damage on a hit. Attacks with the right hand have advantage on targets with 50% or more corruption.
Left Hand. The Left Hand of Madness covers your left hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see your normal arm, but it invokes an inexplicable sense of terror within them. An unarmed strike made with your left hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d6 psychic damage on a hit. On a hit, a creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or gain the frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

True Mania
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Rumination

A creature gains a temporary level of exhaustion while at 50% corruption or two levels of exhaustion at 100%.

Fate

Destined One
Prerequisite: Must have Fate Manipulation

You or the DM chooses one creature you touch as your Destined One. You can always tell where your Destined One is as the thread of Fate always guides your hand. While within 30 ft of your Destined One, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, once per round you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC against an attack roll made against you or to a saving throw you make, potentially changing the outcome. You cannot change the creature chosen as your Destined One unless they die.

Web of Fate
Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Eyes of Fate

When you cast a Fate onto targets, you can instead target a number of creatures equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus within range. If the Fate requires Touch, you must touch all targets of the technique.

Maximum: Shears of Three Fates
Prerequisite: Must have Road of Karma

As an action for 15 cursed energy, you form a scissor with your fingers and snip one of the threads of fate of a creature you can see within 5 ft of you. At the start of each of the target’s turns, they must make a Death saving throw. This roll cannot have advantage or disadvantage or any bonuses or penalties. The target gains 1 level of exhaustion for every failed death save. If the target fails 3 death saves, they fall to 0 hit points and die. They are unable to be revived by cursed techniques. If the target succeeds 3 death saves or you are reduced to 0 hit points or die, the technique ends and the target becomes immune to this technique for 3 days.

G Warstaff

Greater Foresight
Prerequisite: Must have Predictable Strikes

Your foresight ability has reached even greater potential, reaching the point some consider enlightened. Whenever you have advantage because of your technique, you can roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the highest roll. Also, whenever a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you because of your technique, they roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the lowest roll.

GG True Warstaff
Prerequisite: Must have Precognition

You have created a more powerful version of your G Warstaff, being a true weapon of destruction. As a bonus action while you have G Warstaff active, you can spend 4 cursed energy to evolve it into its true form, GG True Warstaff. It gains the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • It deals one additional damage dice

  • Its reach is 15ft instead of 10ft

  • When you score a critical hit against a creature, you gain 2 seconds instead of 1

  • It gains a +1 to critical range

Maximum: Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint
Prerequisite: Must have Storyboard Dominion

You have gained the ability to not only see, but also manipulate the contents of your manga panel. At the beginning of your turn, you can choose a creature that you can see that is marked by 6 seconds and roll a d20. Record the roll. As a reaction, you can replace one roll that creature makes with the result of that roll. At the beginning of your turn, you lose any unused rolls.

Golden Hour

Quick Pose
Prerequisite: Must have Majestic Pose

You have learned to activate your technique in a fraction of a second.

  • When you use Golden Hour, you can instead use it as a free action on your turn instead of as a bonus action.

  • As a reaction for 5 CE, you can stop time for yourself and immediately take one turn. After time resumes, your movement is 0 ft and you cannot take actions until the end of your next turn.

  • At 6th level, you can use Golden Week as a bonus action instead of an action.

Prime Time
Prerequisite: Must have Golden Week

Instead of making your technique last longer, you can increase the intensity to create an even sharper burst.
