You can charge your technique using your action this way for a number of times equal to your CE modifier while concentrating, after which you must release your technique. You can use your reaction to launch either a Sound Blast or Sound Wave at any time while playing this way and add 2 damage die per action you use to play before releasing and ignore resistances.

Emotional Melodies
Prerequisite: Must have Resonating Music

As a bonus action for 5 cursed energy, you can introduce a vibe of your choice for 1 minute while concentrating. You can only have one Vibe active at a time. Deafened creatures automatically succeed.
Happy Vibes. Your music gives happy and upbeat vibes. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or be Charmed and only hear you and your music until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.
Sad Vibes. Your music gives sad and depressed vibes, bringing the mood down. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or fall prone and their speed becomes 0 until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.
Angry Vibes. Your music gives off angry and rebellious vibes! On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or becomes berserk until the Vibe ends. A berserk creature uses their reaction to make a melee attack at the closest creature at the start of their turn and must use their action to attack. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.

Rock Squad
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Epic Solo

Looks like the band is getting back together! An epic guitar solo is always welcome, but people came for a show. When an allied creature ends their turn within 15 feet of you during your Epic Solo, their next attack or technique deals additional d4 in thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Rot

Blood Production
Prerequisite: Must have Rot Techniques

You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Rot features. This does not regain HP.

Condensed Decay
Prerequisite: Must have Scarlet Rot

You have learned to increase the potency of your blood’s properties. When you use a Rot Technique, you can spend additional HP up to twice your CE modifier to increase the damage dice of acid dealt by your technique by one tier for every 2 HP spent (d8<d10<d12) to a max of d12.

Blackened Blood
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King

Your blood has become bubbling and black. A creature that fails a Constitution saving throw against your technique by 5 or more gains a level of exhaustion. A creature cannot gain more than 3 levels of exhaustion from this feature.

Wing King Improvement
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King

You have mastered your Maximum technique, granting you the following benefits while using Wing King:

  • You gain the Evasion feature

  • You can now make four lines of blood attacks as a free action on your turn

  • You can use a Rot Technique as a bonus action

Schrift X

Piercing Burst
Prerequisite: Must have Piercing Schrift

You have perfected your accuracy and combined it with your piercing ability. When you use Piercing Schrift, you can also target additional targets up to your proficiency bonus that are either in front of or behind your target as long as they are within the path of the attack. You use the attack roll against the original target to determine if you would hit the additional targets.

Cursed Seal Expert
Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Mark

Through diligent practice and creativity, you have created new types of cursed seals. You gain the following options:

  • Blinding Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, removing the blinded condition on a success.

  • Crippling Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw or have either their movement speed halved for 1 minute or disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute (your choice). A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

Maximum: Sancrosanct
Prerequisite: Must have Intangibility

You have practiced and mastered your technique allowing you to utilize it flawlessly. When you activate Intangibility, you are instead resistant to all damage other than psychic, but are still able to use your Innate Technique features and for the duration you can use Piercing Schrift for free once per turn.

Seance

Bestial Seance
Prerequisite: Must have Seance

You have learned to bring a bit of whimsy to your usually ghastly technique. When you use Seance on yourself, you can choose to instead channel the Physical Information of a Beast with a CR equal to or less than your proficiency bonus. You gain all the creature’s traits, senses, movements and actions in addition to the normal effects of Physical Information. To use this technique, you must be wearing a costume of that specific animal, costing $200 x the Beast’s CR. You can wear this costume with armor, but if it takes an amount of damage (other than psychic) equal to 3 x your level, it becomes unusable and you lose any benefits from this feature.

Perfect Ritual
Prerequisite: Must have Ritual of Resurrection

You won’t allow anyone to interrupt your seance. You have advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration for your Seance technique and the time to complete your Ritual is decreased to 3 rounds. Additionally, you decrease the saving throw DC a target makes against the dead humanoid’s Soul Information by your CE modifier.

Cling to Life
Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Black Seance

When a target runs out of cursed energy and can no longer maintain the seance, they can choose to forcefully hold the spirit within their body. At the beginning of the target’s turn, they instead spend 5 HP, reducing their maximum by the same amount. Your hit point maximum is restored by 15 after each long rest.

Shadow Killer

Shadow User
Prerequisite: Must have Shadow Strike

You have furthered the uses of your shadow choosing one of the following features (This feat can be taken multiple times).

  • Shadow Skulker. As an action for 2 CE you physically enter the shadows gaining full cover for X rounds or until you exit from a shadow within 10 feet. As an action while the technique is active, you can move into a shadow within 10 ft. You can hear and see through the shadow you entered. If the shadow is sufficiently illuminated, you exit the shadow. (X = CE mod)

  • Shadow Envoy. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can imbue your cursed energy into a creature's shadow within 5 ft. To attempt this technique without them noticing, you must make a Cursed Energy check against their passive perception. You can imbue conditions for when the technique is triggered. You can choose to leave either a melee attack with a range of 10 ft using Shadow Strike or a simple message. If you choose to leave a Shadow Strike, it targets a specific creature under a condition you set, uses your Cursed Energy modifier and is made at advantage if the target is unaware. If you choose a message, you can choose to leave five words. When you create the message, you can choose any number of creatures who can see the message in the shadow.

  • Two shadow spells below 5th level. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

Improved Bindings
Prerequisite: Must have Dark Binding

You have improved your technique and can cause shadows to physically wrap around the target, giving you the following additional effects when you use your technique:

  • A creature must spend an attack to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to remove the weapon.

  • The target is treated as having two levels of exhaustion.

  • The target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of their turn or be stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

Maximum: Heavenly Star of Darkness
Prerequisite: Must have Shadows of Mortality

As an action for 10 cursed energy, you invoke primordial darkness, forming a dark sun 300 ft in the sky that inhabits a 30 ft sphere for 1 minute. A creature that enters the 30 ft sphere the dark sun inhabits takes 4d6 necrotic damage and and again at the start of their turns. At the end of the minute, you can spend 1 cursed energy to increase the duration by 1 minute. The technique ends if you become incapacitated. The dark sun radiates magical darkness within 600 ft of it that you can see normally in and any light from a technique costing less than 5 cursed energy is suppressed within this area. Any creature within that range with a Cursed Energy score or Passive perception higher than your Cursed Energy save DC can see through this magical darkness as if it were dim light.
You can use Shadow Strike against a creature within this area without spending cursed energy and the target has disadvantage on Dexterity saves to protect their shadow. If you spend cursed energy on Shadow Strike against a creature within this area, they are considered vulnerable to the damage.

Shrine

Chainsaw Dismantle
Prerequisite: Must have Dismantle

Once per turn, you can spend 2 CE to apply Dismantle to your punches. When you make an unarmed strike you deal 1d12 additional slashing damage. This increases to 2d12 at 6th level, 3d12 at 11th level and 4d12 at 18th level. At 11th level, you can use Chainsaw Dismantle as a reaction to an attack. You roll the damage for your Dismantle based on the CE you spend and reduce the damage by that amount. If this reduces the damage to 0, the attack is nullified.

Spiderweb
Prerequisites: Must have Cleave

Your Cleave has grown more versatile. For 1 extra Cursed energy you can touch an object or structure and make Cleave into a 30 ft cone which only damages objects and structures in contact with each other. This deals critical damage, creating difficult terrain and potentially destroying terrain and footholds causing creatures to fall. If this does not cause a creature within range to fall, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

Disassembly
Prerequisites: Must have Slicing and Severing

You have learned to further segment your attacks. When you spend more than 1 CE for Dismantle, you can instead fire multiple slashes splitting damage die between the slashes before attacking and making separate attack rolls for each.

Maximum: World Cutting Slash
Prerequisites: Must have Malevolent Shrine

You have broadened your understanding, cutting the area your target is in instead of the target itself. You can spend the maximum amount of cursed energy on Dismantle as an action to instead target one creature within 60 ft you can see. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take maximum damage, on a success they take half as much maximum damage. This damage ignores resistances, immunities, temporary hit points, cover, obstacles, bonuses to saving throws (from techniques) and cursed techniques. This is a limb damaging effect and can target any limb on the limb damage table.

Sky Manipulation

Cloak of Invisibility
Prerequisites: Must have Sky Shape

As an action, for 3 Cursed Energy you can cast the invisibility spell as the sky surrounds you preventing others from seeing you. When you reach third level, you also gain the benefits of Sky Armor when invisible.

Spatial Shatter
Prerequisites: Must have Thin Ice Breaker

You can spend 6 CE to make an attack on your turn into a melee cursed energy attack roll using a melee weapon or unarmed strike. On a hit, you deal damage as normal and the target also suffers the effects of Thin Ice Breaker.

Maximum: Hurricane
Prerequisites: Must have Thin Ice Breaker

As an action, for 10 Cursed Energy you can spin the space around you forcing all creatures in a 30 foot radius to make a Strength saving throw or be launched 1000 feet into the air as the space rebounds upwards.

Solo Forbidden Zone

Blessing of Resilience
Prerequisites: Must have Bless

You have mastered Blessing those within your Zone. Those in your Zone have their output and durability increased. When you create your Zone, all allies in range gain temporary hit points at the start of their turns equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

Blessing of Combat
Prerequisites: Must have Ritual Dance

When you use Forbidden Zone, you maximize a creature’s output offensively. Allies in your Zone can add a d4 to attack and damage rolls.

Maximum: Shrine of The Gods
Prerequisites: Must have Maximize Output

When setting up your Ritual Zone as part of your full turn action, you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to roll a d10. Instead of you having to maintain your zone each turn, it instead lasts for a number of rounds equal to the number rolled + your Cursed Energy modifier.

Star Dictator

Domineering Shikigami
Prerequisite: Must have Minor Star Shikigami

You have learned that strengthening cursed energy lets you summon stronger shikigami. Your Minor Star Shikigami gain the following benefits.

  • The Shikigami’s Bite attack increases to 1d6. It becomes 1d8 at 6th level and 1d10 at 11th level.

  • The Shikigami gains a +2 bonus to their Dexterity score and again at 6th, and 11th level (max of 20).

  • When the shikigami is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

Tyrant Shikigami
Prerequisite: Must have Major Star Shikigami

You have learned that strengthening cursed energy lets you summon stronger shikigami. You can spend 1 additional cursed energy when you summon your Major Star Shikigami to increase its size category to Large. This increases to 2 cursed energy to make it Huge at 11th level and 4 cursed energy to make it Gargantuan at 18th level. For every size category larger than medium, it gains the following:

  • +4 bonus to Strength score

  • +1d8 damage to Bite attacks

  • +30 hit points

Judicial Amputation
Prerequisites: Must have Army of the Dictator

If a creature fails their saving throw against your pseudo-domain by 5 or more, the damage is treated as having the Limb Removing Effect and targets one of their arms or legs.

Star Rage

Massive Push
Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Increase

After landing a critical you can choose to also push the creature 30 feet away. If they hit a solid object or structure, they take the remaining distance as fall damage.

Shooting Star
Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Improvement

When you have your mass increased, you can spend 3 Cursed Energy once per round to replace one of your attacks by kicking or throwing an object with massive strength. This creates a 5 foot wide, 60 feet long line, causing all creatures within range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking twice your unarmed strike damage on a failed save. This has the limb damaging effect on a failed save.

Maximum: Black Hole
Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Mastery

As an action you can sacrifice yourself, becoming a Black Hole for 1 minute, after which you die. This creates a 100 foot radius of difficult terrain where all creatures within range make a Strength saving throw at the end of your turn, being pulled 50 feet closer on a failed save or 25 feet on a success. If a creature or object gets within 5 feet of you as a result of this forced movement, they are sucked into the black hole and die.

Starlight Symphony

Enduring Shikigami
Prerequisite: Must have Kitsune Creation

You have learned to remove the time limit of your shikigami. Your fox shikigami (other than Inari) last until reduced to 0 hit points and you can add your proficiency bonus to any saving throws your shikigami make. You are still limited by the number of shikigami you can have active at once.

Fox Fire
Prerequisite: Must have Living Fog

You can create incredibly dense fog that can be triggered to erupt in a vapor explosion. For an additional 3 CE when you create an area of Cursed Fog, you make the fog incredibly thick. As an action, you can cause the fog to detonate in a vapor explosion. All creatures within the fog other than yourself must make a Constitution saving throw, taking twice your Cursed Energy modifier in d8s of cold damage or half as much damage on a success as a blue explosion rips through, igniting the fog.

Maximum: Fog of Exorcism
Prerequisite: Must have Inari

As an action for 10 cursed energy, you can blast a 60 ft cone with an erupting wave of destructive exploding fog. All creatures within range must make a Constitution saving throw, taking twice your CE modifier XD10 + 6d10 cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a success. If a creature is a cursed spirit, the damage ignores any resistance to cold damage and it makes the save at disadvantage. If used at Maximum Output, Cursed spirits automatically fail their saving throw.

Straw Doll Technique

Nail Volley
Prerequisites: Must have Nail Projectiles

As an action, for as much Cursed Energy as nails you unleash your nails in a cone equal to ten times the nails used you can force creatures in the area to do a Dexterity save or take a number of d6 equal to the nails used.

1000 Needles
Prerequisites: Must have Hairpin

When you use Hairpin, you can spend an additional 1 cursed energy per nail. If the creature fails its saves, it becomes Restrained by needles of cursed energy. An affected creature can make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your cursed energy save at the end of their turn, freeing themselves on a success. On a failure, they take 1d8 piercing damage.

Maximum: Last Nail in the Coffin
Prerequisites: Must have Improved Resonance

You have mastered the Straw Doll Technique, when you use your action to damage a straw doll with Resonance, for 8 Cursed Energy you can choose to land an Improved Resonance.

Technique Extermination

Blessed Blow
Prerequisites: Must have Extinguishment

On a hit you can spend 2 Cursed Energy to deal an additional 2d12 radiant damage. You can increase the damage by 1d12 by spending an additional Cursed Energy. You can only spend as much cursed energy as your Cursed Energy modifier using this feature.

Archangel’s Present
Prerequisites: Must have Angel’s Blessing, Breakthrough

You gain a Blessing from the Dungeon Master’s Guide.

Sword of Michael
Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Jacob’s Ladder

Through rigorous effort and control, you have managed to convince the might of Jacob’s Ladder into a single blow. As an action for 8 Cursed Energy, you can make a melee Cursed Energy attack against a single creature. On a hit that creature will then suffer the full effects of Jacob’s Ladder without a saving throw.

Teleportation

Offensive Shunt
Prerequisites: Must have Teleport

You have learned to use your technique offensively. When you mark an object that is Small size category or smaller, you can spend 3 CE to forcefully teleport it into a space occupied by a creature within 60 ft that you can see, which forces a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object teleports into their body and they take Xd6 force damage that ignores damage resistances (X = proficiency bonus). At 6th level, you can spend additional CE up to your proficiency bonus to increase the die tier of Offensive Shunt by 1 per CE spent up to a maximum of d12s (d6 > d8 > d10 > d12).
At 11th level, when teleporting a willing or unwilling creature, you can spend an additional 6 CE to teleport them into an area occupied by a Large size category object or structure or larger within 30 ft that you can see. Both the creature and the object or structure take double the damage of your Offensive Shunt. If this destroys the object or structure, the creature falls prone. Otherwise, the target is restrained in the item until removed or the obstruction is destroyed.

Perfected Teleport
Prerequisite: Must have Mastered Teleport

You're grown more efficient with your teleports and have perfected their efficiency to reduce cursed energy costs. The cost to use your technique instead becomes 1 CE and the cost to cast Teleport is reduced by your CE modifier.
Maximum: Soul Swap
Prerequisite: Must have Improved Marking

With creative thinking you’ve figured out teleporting the souls of creatures. As an action for 6 CE with two willing creatures you touch, you mark and swap the souls of the creatures. For 1 hour or until you dismiss it (no action required), all of the creatures’ game statistics are swapped except for mental stats (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma) and any non-Physical feats. They lose access to their Innate Technique features and gain the other’s Technique and cursed energy, hit points, racial features, and weapon proficiencies.
Body Training. When the swap ends both creatures are returned to their original bodies, reverting all changes, but each creature can ignore one prerequisite of any feats the other creature used while in their body, except for prerequisites that require you to be or not be a certain race, have a certain cursed technique, require other feats, require a breakthrough, or require you to be a certain class. A creature can only be swapped twice in one month, after which you must wait one month before swapping that creature again. If a creature dies while swapped, the other dies once the duration ends.
RCT Training. Once per month if swapped with an RCT user, after training for the full duration and spending at least 20 CE utilizing RCT, a creature without can roll the d100 to attempt RCT Breakthrough with a +5 bonus to the success range. Even if the roll fails, the success range for future d100 rolls for RCT permanently increases by +1 to a maximum of +3. If you fail this roll 3 times, you can no longer make this roll using Soul Swap.

Ten Shadows

Shadow User
Prerequisites: Must have Divine Dogs

You have furthered your use of shadows. Choose one of the following features (This feat can be taken multiple times).

  • Shadow Skulker. As an action for 2 CE you physically enter the shadows gaining full cover for a turn or until you exit from a shadow within 10 feet. At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 CE to remain in the shadow. You can hear and see through the shadow and can summon tamed shikigami within the shadow. If the shadow is sufficiently illuminated, you exit the shadow.

  • Shadow Ridge. As a reaction for 1 CE against a melee attack, you force a creature within 10 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the target rolls the attack at disadvantage as their legs fall into their shadow briefly and they fall prone. You can instead spend 3 CE to give the target disadvantage on the save.

  • Two shadow spells below 5th level. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

Chimerafication
Prerequisites: Must have Totality

You have learned how to better fuse the powers of your Shadows even at the cost of creating a monstrosity. When creating a Totality, you can sacrifice a tamed shikigami even if it is not destroyed. You can use a number of shikigami up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) + 1 that are eligible for Totality to fuse into an eligible Non-Totality shikigami, forming a Chimera. Chimeras can have humanoid forms, but cannot be used for Well’s Unknown Abyss.
You can also give an additional alteration to your altered shikigami created with Well’s Unknown Abyss, counting as part of the technique.

Maximum: Embodiment
Prerequisite: Must have Chimera Shadow Garden

As an action, you can spend half the cost (min of 1) of one of your tamed shikigami (no Totality or Chimera). Rather than summoning, you instead gain their movement, actions, legendary actions, features and one ability score of your choice from the shikigami for 1 hour. (Eg. Divine Dog’s movement, Max Elephant’s Constitution, or Mahoraga’s Adaption.) You can embody one shikigami at a time.

Tool Manipulation

Tools of the Craft
Prerequisite: Must have Guided Control

You can imbue a set of tools with your cursed energy, such as artisan’s tools or thieve’s tools. You can use your CE modifier for ability checks made using these tools and gain a +1 bonus for each CE spent on the imbuement up to a maximum of your CE modifier.

Eyes in the Skies
Prerequisite: Must have Floating Tool Improvement

When you are riding your Floating Tool, you gain a +5 bonus to your passive Perception and Investigation and can use your CE modifier for Dexterity saving throws.

Maximum: Tsukumogami
Prerequisite: Must have Tool Mastery

As an action for 8 CE, you can imbue a cursed tool with sentience, causing it to come to life and become a Tsukumogami for 1 hour. Your Tsukumogami is always under the effects of Floating Tool and can freely move by itself. It does not count against the number of Floating Tools you can have at once, but you can only have one Tsukumogami at a time.
The Tsukumogami can take an action on your turn while you are holding it. That action can be used only to take the Attack action (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action. If you use Wind Scythe or Combat Tool Improvement’s reaction with your Tsukumogami, you can roll three additional dice.

Triple Core

Maximum: Crippling Strikes
Prerequisites: Must have Unblockable Blows

You have mastered your Unblockable Blows core option. Your blows can now treat immunity as resistance by spending 1 additional CE. You can now spend more than 1 CE in an attack.

Maximum: Blast Away
Prerequisites: Must have Energy Blast

You have improved your output. When you use your Energy Blast core option with at least 4 CE, the damage dice becomes d8 and creatures must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked 10ft back and fall prone.

Maximum: Fortress
Prerequisites: Must have Defensive Form

When you use your Defensive Form core option, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to four times your current CE. While you have these temporary hit points, you are resistant to Piercing, Bludgeoning, and Slashing damage.

Maximum: Blitz
Prerequisite: Must have Divebomb

You have hastened yourself even further. When you use your Divebomb core option, you instead increase your speed by 15 ft per CE spent and you gain a +4 bonus to AC. You deal an additional 1d6 damage for every 10 ft you move in a straight line before hitting a target with a melee attack.

Vengeful Spirit Manipulation

Partial Manifestation Versatility
Prerequisites: Must have Partial Manifestation

Your manipulation over the manifestation of limbs and such increase. The range of your partial manifestation attacks increases to 15 ft. Additionally, when you hit with one of these attacks, you can attempt to grapple or shove the target as part of the attack.

Technique Storage
Prerequisites: Must have Mimicry

When you copy techniques, you can keep more in the Vengeful Spirit. You can store twice as many techniques, with any additional techniques being stored within your spirit. You must use an action to retrieve them while within 5 ft of the Vengeful Spirit while it is summoned.
While your Vengeful Spirit is summoned, the number of times you can use a copied technique feature before it disappears increases by your CE modifier. The increased number of uses does not reset when your Vengeful Spirit is resummoned.

Free Spirit
Prerequisites: Must have Stronger Bond

You and your spirit have finally made amends, making it finally pass on to the afterlife. However, the spirit left you a present before going. Your Vengeful Spirit is now fully under your control, not being berserk when you summon it. It is now a Shikigami instead of a Cursed Spirit. Although you can use your action to give it an order, making it act on its own to complete the order. While summoned, you can use your action to borrow its power, drawing cursed energy equal to your level into yourself from its pool once per day. The spirit can only be active for a number of minutes equal to your CE modifier per day, these minutes do not need to be consecutive.

Voracity

Cannibalism
Prerequisite: Must have Hunger of the Accursed

Your hunger has overwhelmed your humanity and led you to resort to this inhumane act. You can now devour the corpses of human races and use them for your innate technique features. You can take a Class Feature or Innate Technique feature using the rules of Hunger of the Accursed from a dead humanoid, changing parts of your appearance to resemble them when used. You cannot take Domain Expansions using this feature.
When you steal a cursed technique or innate technique feature from a dead humanoid, you can only take it if you are of the correct level and fulfill any prerequisites for using it. Additionally, you can only spend the base cost the technique requires. No matter what you copy, you can only use the technique in its base form. For example, a maximum output hollow purple would only come as a hollow purple. This changes if used with the Output option of Digestion at 6th level.

Necrophage
Prerequisite: Must have Regurgitation

You have learned to more accurately extract the cursed energy from a corpse that is required for your technique. You can now devour a corpse as an action for 3 cursed energy that has been dead for a number of days equal to your Cursed Energy modifier and still have it usable for your technique if the creature’s CR equals your level. This increases to twice your Cursed Energy modifier at 11th level and three times at 18th level.

Gourmand
Prerequisite: Must have Body of the Devourer

You have learned to appreciate the good food you have eaten. When you use Regurgitation, you gain temporary hit points equal to half the hit points of the creature whose devoured ability you are calling upon. The amount of temporary hit points cannot exceed half your hit point maximum.
